//stt: whisper-cpp:       whisper.cpp's whisper-server, on this machine or another. Needs url.
openai-compatible: POST {url}/audio/transcriptions. Needs url and model.
Groq:   { provider: openai-compatible, url: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, model: whisper-large-v3 }
OpenAI: { provider: openai-compatible, url: https://api.openai.com/v1, model: whisper-1 }
sarvam:            POST {url}/speech-to-text. Indian languages and code-mixed speech.
Sarvam: { provider: sarvam, model: saaras:v3, language: unknown }
url and model default; language is BCP-47 (hi-IN, en-IN, ta-IN) or unknown to auto-detect.
Either provider may carry a credential, sent as Bearer: apiKey, apiKeyEnv, or apiKeyFile.
apiKeyFile is a path relative to this file; setup writes those with mode 0600.
//whatsapp: OPTIONAL. Register a dedicated number with Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API and expose
https://your-host/webhooks/whatsapp. Voice notes capture; text messages use Ask.
allowedFrom is the explicit vault access list: country code + number, digits only.
Keep the access token, Meta app secret, and your random webhook verify token outside this file.
//ask: OPTIONAL. Delete this whole block and capture still works with no account and no key;
POST /ask just returns 501. Adding it turns on question answering over your notes.
anthropic:         model e.g. claude-sonnet-5. Key here or in $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
openai-compatible: one adapter covering Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI,
Groq, OpenRouter, Together. Needs baseUrl. Local needs no key.
Ollama: { provider: openai-compatible, baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, model: qwen2.5:7b }
OpenRouter: { provider: openai-compatible, baseUrl: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, model: openrouter/free, apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY }
